authorization: The owner found it hard to see their purchased credits and asked for a simple, elegant place to see and add credits with a placeholder for a future profile, designed with the council, "end-to-end full send"; then asked to finish the lane, deploy included, "end to end full send". Spends nothing.

release.reviewFindings: #494: five-seat council chose the design 3-2 and approved two code-review rounds (scores 8-9); CodeRabbit had no actionable comments. #495: GPT-6.2 Sol (xhigh) approved in one round with nits; CodeRabbit skipped (review limit). CI quality-gates passed on both.

changes: A glass account chip beside the Visibible name shows a person and the available balance on every spread; an admin sees a shield, and loading or unavailable shows the person alone. It is the button's description, not its name, and hides in the whole-picture view.

The corner menu opens on the account: "Guest · Kept in this browser" ("Admin" for an admin, "Account" until the session is read), the balance with Get credits (focused when the menu opens), Recover credits, then Admin sign-in with ?admin.
The name and the chip fade on their own so the chip's glass keeps its blur; focus on the name still holds the fade, and the button's hover fill clears while idle.
